description: This Java class defines a MessageTap consumer that inspects messages to determine if a device is ready to receive data and triggers corresponding callbacks.

classes.name: MessageTap
classes.description: A final class implementing Consumer<Message> that inspects messages and triggers callbacks based on message content.

methods.name: getConsumer
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a MessageTap consumer which checks for device readiness indications in messages and invokes provided callbacks.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Overrides the Consumer.accept method to delegate message processing to the internal tapConsumer.
